description: Dinâmica Agropecuária is a series of datasets listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Quantidade de cachaça do Brasil exportado pelo porto de Santos em 2016, por país de destino em mil toneladas Dados do Universo. A estatísitca do comércio exterior retrata e avalia o movimento comercial do País com as demais nações do mundo, englobando as vendas e compras efetuadas externamente. Coverage: Brasil. The portal lists 19 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. Its tags are Dinâmica Territorial da Produção Agropecuária, Geografia da Cana, Cana-de-açúcar, cachaça, exportação. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
